description: Docker executable unavailable in implementation environment. Before publishing image/Gist, run matrix in test/docker/README.md: build final image, Compose config validation, fresh local/installer volumes, successful provision gating before migrations, down/up and recreated one-shot job, owner read-only volume UID/modes, private secret isolation, failures and mismatched volumes block app. Test pgvector/pg18 and paradedb:0.23.0 with candidate image. Confirm ordinary restart retains DB credentials and data. Source tests (36) and 99% Python coverage pass locally plus canonical DBA suites for both engines. Publishing requires user approval and image-before-Gist order. Do not change zaq-local.sh. Test-first matrix already documented; no mocks; update docs only if actual Docker behavior requires correction.
title: [zaq-f6s] Verify image lifecycle on Docker-capable runner before rollout
